_comment: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for every external input of this build.
Every git source is pinned to a full 40-hex commit (the 'ref' field is only the human-readable tag/branch it was resolved from on 2026-10-04).
Every tarball is pinned to url + sha256.
tools/apply_pins.py rewrites the upstream package files so that GIT_TAG == rev, and FAILS the build if any package in the final package list has no pin here.
To bump a pin: change 'rev' (and 'ref'/'version'), re-run the workflow, read README.md section 'Bumping a pin'.

upstream_recipe.name: shinchiro/mpv-winbuild-cmake
upstream_recipe.ref: master (HEAD on 2026-10-04, last commit 2026-09-19 'libvpl: fix MinGW secure string macro conflicts')
upstream_recipe.license: NONE PUBLISHED (GitHub reports license=null, no LICENSE file). Therefore it is NOT vendored: it is checked out at build time at this exact commit and our overlay/ is copied over it. See NOTICE.

build_host.arch_archive_note: pacman is pointed at https://archive.archlinux.org/repos/<snapshot>/ and run with -Syyuu, so the installed host package set (clang, cmake, meson, nasm, python-jinja, ...) is frozen to that day.

cmake_externalproject.note: The upstream recipe curl's this file from a mutable tag at configure time; our overlay/cmake/download_externalproject.cmake fetches it by commit and verifies the sha256.

upstream_files_expected_sha256._comment: sha256 of every upstream file that we replace (overlay/) or text-edit (tools/apply_pins.py) at the pinned upstream commit. apply_pins.py refuses to touch a file whose hash differs, so bumping upstream_recipe.rev forces a conscious re-review.

sources.name: llvm
sources.license: Apache-2.0 WITH LLVM-exception (clang, lld, compiler-rt, libc++, libc++abi, libunwind)
sources.why: Host+target compiler. Upstream tracks branch release/23.x; we pin the 23.1.2 release tag (same release series the recipe is written for, clang_version=23).

sources.name: mingw-w64
sources.ref: master @ 2026-10-03 (newest commit before the reference build, 2026-10-04 12:00Z)
sources.why: Upstream recipe tracks master and is tuned to it; v14.0.0 (9b3dd0125792fe94d16cacdc596dbd42fca1b369, 2026-03-24) is the fallback if master breaks.

sources.name: zlib
sources.why: ffmpeg png/exr/tiff/mov decoders and mpv need inflate.

sources.name: libiconv
sources.why: Charset conversion for libass / mpv (static).

sources.name: fribidi
sources.why: Hard dependency of libass (OSD text).

sources.name: freetype2
sources.license: FTL (BSD-style) OR GPL-2.0-only -- we use it under the FTL
sources.why: Hard dependency of libass.

sources.name: harfbuzz
sources.why: Hard dependency of libass.

sources.name: libass
sources.why: mpv meson.build has an unconditional dependency('libass') (OSD/subtitles); cannot be removed.

sources.name: nvcodec-headers
sources.why: Headers only; dlopen()s nvcuda/nvcuvid at runtime for nvdec + CUDA/GL interop. No NVIDIA code is shipped.

sources.name: xxhash
sources.why: Used by libplacebo (shader cache hashing) and dav1d's muxer option in the upstream recipe.

sources.name: dav1d
sources.why: Software AV1 decoder (ffmpeg libdav1d). Official upstream is code.videolan.org/videolan/dav1d; the GitHub mirror has identical history so the commit hash is the same (the upstream recipe's code.videolan.org URL is replaced by the mirror because CI runners are frequently rate-limited there).

sources.name: lcms2
sources.why: ICC colour management for libplacebo/mpv (kept for parity with the verified reference build; tools/jpeg/tiff disabled).

sources.name: libzimg
sources.why: mpv prefers zimg for software pixel-format conversion (float/16-bit EXR, DPX frames). Kept for parity with the verified reference build; set -Dzimg=disabled + drop this entry to remove (README).

sources.name: glad
sources.ref: glad2 branch = v2.0.8 = libplacebo v7.360.1 submodule 3rdparty/glad
sources.license: MIT (generator); generated GL loader is public domain/MIT
sources.why: Build-time only: libplacebo generates its OpenGL loader with it.

sources.name: vulkan-header
sources.why: Build-time only: libplacebo compiles src/vulkan/stubs.c even with -Dvulkan=disabled and that includes <vulkan/vulkan.h>. Headers only, no Vulkan code in the DLL.

sources.name: fast_float
sources.why: Header-only, build-time input of libplacebo.

sources.name: spirv-headers
sources.why: Build-time input of SPIRV-Tools, glslang and shaderc (SPIR-V enum/grammar headers; their constants end up compiled into the DLL). Exactly the revision named in shaderc's DEPS file at the pinned shaderc commit.

sources.name: spirv-tools
sources.why: Linked into shaderc (SPIR-V validation/optimisation); statically part of libmpv-2.dll. Exactly the revision named in shaderc's DEPS file.

sources.name: glslang
sources.why: GLSL front end inside shaderc (GLSL -> SPIR-V) for the D3D11 GPU output; statically part of libmpv-2.dll. Exactly the revision named in shaderc's DEPS file.

sources.name: shaderc
sources.ref: main @ 2026-10-02 (newest commit before the pin date 2026-10-04)
sources.why: The GLSL -> SPIR-V compiler that mpv (-Dshaderc=enabled) and libplacebo (-Dshaderc=enabled) need for the Direct3D 11 backend (vo=gpu-next, gpu-api=d3d11). Built as libshaderc_combined.a and linked statically; no tests, no executables.

sources.name: spirv-cross
sources.why: SPIR-V -> HLSL translation used by libplacebo's and mpv's Direct3D 11 backends (required by mpv -Dd3d11=enabled -Dspirv-cross=enabled). C API library only, built static (patches/spirv-cross-0001-static-c-api.patch); no CLI.

sources.name: libplacebo
sources.why: Hard dependency of mpv (>=7.360.1). Built with the OpenGL and Direct3D 11 backends (D3D11 via shaderc + SPIRV-Cross, statically linked); no Vulkan, no separate glslang backend.

sources.name: angle-headers
sources.ref: main @ 2026-07-06 (already the GIT_RESET pin of the upstream recipe)
sources.why: EGL/KHR headers so that mpv can compile its d3d11->EGL(ANGLE) interop code. No ANGLE binary is built or shipped.

sources.name: ffmpeg
sources.ref: master @ 2026-10-04T11:54Z 'avcodec/mpeg12dec: reject a picture in the extradata' (== ffmpeg-lgpl-x86_64-git-f1a000d41 of the verified reference release)
sources.why: Exactly the ffmpeg commit that the verified reference libmpv (mpv 413ff0b1cd) was built with. depth 0 (blobless full history) so that `git describe` gives a real version string.

sources.name: mpv
sources.ref: master @ 2026-10-03 'ci: enable vapoursynth' (== libmpv 0.41.0-1095 of the verified reference release)
sources.why: Same commit as the verified reference binary. The nearest release tag (v0.41.0) is 1095 commits older and would silently drop fixes the app was verified against; a pinned commit is as reproducible as a tag.

patches_sha256._comment: Verbatim upstream-project patches applied by package recipes (patches/ is outside overlay/, so it does not touch the toolchain cache key). Re-check with sha256sum when changing.
